meta.wind_generation: Native CLIMADA chain: STORM -> tracks -> TropCyclone.from_tracks
meta.wind_metric_mean_semantics: Per retained cell, mean mode stores the frequency-weighted mean over positive STORM event intensities; no territorial median is used.
meta.wind_metric_return_level_semantics: Per retained cell, rp50/rp100 modes store return levels extracted from the exceedance-frequency curve over positive STORM event intensities; no territorial median is used.
meta.wind_metric_event_max_semantics: Per retained cell, event_max mode stores the maximum positive STORM event intensity.
meta.wind_display_range_semantics: Legend min/max values are computed across retained territory cells for the selected metric.
meta.surge_generation: Native CLIMADA chain: STORM -> TropCyclone -> TCSurgeBathtub.from_tc_winds
meta.rain_generation: Native CLIMADA chain: STORM -> tracks -> TCRain.from_tracks (event-total intensity in mm)
meta.cell_clip_rule: Only cells intersecting the territory mask are retained; each display point is the representative point of the land portion of the cell.
